title: Excess Mileage Rate Relief for Full-Term Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Leases
content:
**Rate schedule — excess mileage rate for leases that ran their full term, Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease**

**Schedule.** The excess mileage rate is:

| Whole months the lease ran, lease date to turn-in date | Annual mileage allowance carried | Rate per mile |
|---|---|---|
| at least the lease term in months | 15000 miles (the high allowance) | the lease's excess mileage rate less $0.05 |
| at least the lease term in months | 12000 miles (the standard allowance) | the lease's excess mileage rate less $0.02 |
| any other case | — | the lease's excess mileage rate, not reduced |

**Counting the months.** A month is counted only when the day of the month of the turn-in date is on or after that of the lease date.

**Boundaries (hypothetical 36-month lease dated March 20, 2022)**

| Turn-in date | Whole months run | Allowance | Rate recorded $0.25 becomes |
|---|---|---|---|
| March 20, 2025 | 36 | 15000 | $0.20 |
| March 19, 2025 | 35 | 15000 | $0.25 |
| April 2, 2025 | 36 | 12000 | $0.23 |
| March 25, 2025 | 36 | 10000 | $0.25 |

**Hypothetical illustration**: a sedan lease at a recorded rate of $0.20 per mile, 12000 miles a year, that ran its full 36 months bills its excess miles at $0.18 per mile.
